Draw lollipop annotations on a protein-coordinate track

Source: R/geom-protein-lollipop.R
geom_protein_lollipop.Rd

Draw a backbone, optional domains, curved stems, and mutation heads. With ggexon(SynIndividual) or ggexon(SynSpecies), each component resolves its data from attached protein annotations during plot build. Coordinates stay in amino-acid units; no genomic projection is performed.

Usage

geom_protein_lollipop(
  mutations = NULL,
  domains = NULL,
  protein_length = NULL,
  position = "position",
  score = NULL,
  domain_start = "start",
  domain_end = "end",
  domain = NULL,
  domain_ymin = NULL,
  domain_ymax = NULL,
  spread_threshold = 7,
  protein_start = 0,
  track_ymin = 0.4,
  track_ymax = 0.6,
  domain_default_ymin = 0.35,
  domain_default_ymax = 0.65,
  mutation_y = 1,
  mutation_y_by = NULL,
  mutation_y_strategy = c("scaled", "bins"),
  mutation_y_range = c(0.85, 1.45),
  mutation_y_trans = "identity",
  mutation_y_breaks = NULL,
  mutation_y_values = NULL,
  stem_points = 30,
  curve_k = 1,
  show_backbone = TRUE,
  show_domains = TRUE,
  show_stems = TRUE,
  show_points = TRUE,
  backbone_fill = "grey80",
  backbone_colour = NA,
  domain_colour = NA,
  stem_colour = "grey30",
  stem_linewidth = 0.4,
  point_size = 4,
  point_colour = "black",
  show.legend = NA,
  data = NULL,
  annotation = NULL,
  domain_annotation = NULL,
  individual = NULL,
  species = NULL,
  genes = NULL,
  ids = NULL,
  event_type = NULL,
  min_sample_count = NULL,
  strains = NULL,
  mutation = NULL
)

Arguments

mutations

Optional mutation table or Syn object. Omit to inherit the plot's Syn object.

domains

Optional interval table, S4Vectors::DataFrame, or SynProteinDomainAnnotation object. Intervals must use the same coordinate system as mutations.

protein_length

Optional full protein length. For Syn input, omitted values are resolved from stored lengths or a matching protein sequence. For explicit tables, the maximum mutation position/domain end is used.

position

Column in mutations containing mutation positions.

score

Optional column in mutations used for lollipop point colour, for example a BLOSUM score.

domain_start, domain_end

Domain interval start/end columns.

domain

Optional domain label column. When omitted, a suitable domain column is inferred from common InterProScan/domain-table names.

domain_ymin, domain_ymax

Optional domain y-bound columns. If omitted, existing ymin/ymax columns are used when present.

spread_threshold

Minimum x-distance between adjacent lollipop heads.

protein_start

Start coordinate for the backbone rectangle.

track_ymin, track_ymax

Backbone y-range.

domain_default_ymin, domain_default_ymax

Default y-range for domain intervals when the interval table does not already contain y columns.

mutation_y

Fixed y coordinate for lollipop heads when mutation_y_by is NULL.

mutation_y_by

Optional numeric column in mutations used to map lollipop heads to multiple y levels, for example "sample_count".

mutation_y_strategy

Height-mapping strategy used when mutation_y_by is supplied. "scaled" rescales values into mutation_y_range; "bins" assigns values to tiered y levels.

mutation_y_range

Numeric length-2 y range used by non-fixed height strategies.

mutation_y_trans

Transformation applied before height mapping. One of "identity", "log10", "log2", "log", "sqrt", or a function. Log and square-root transformations require non-negative values and logs use value + 1, which is convenient for count data.

mutation_y_breaks

Optional numeric upper bounds for mutation_y_strategy = "bins", expressed on the original mutation_y_by scale.

mutation_y_values

Optional numeric y levels for mutation_y_strategy = "bins". When mutation_y_breaks is supplied, this must have length length(mutation_y_breaks) + 1.

stem_points

Number of points used per stem curve.

curve_k

Sigmoid steepness for curved stems.

show_backbone, show_domains, show_stems, show_points

Logical switches for layer components.

backbone_fill, backbone_colour

Backbone rectangle styling.

domain_colour

Domain rectangle outline colour.

stem_colour, stem_linewidth

Stem styling.

point_size, point_colour

Mutation point styling. point_colour is used only when score is NULL; otherwise point colour is mapped to lollipop_score.

show.legend

Passed to generated ggplot2 layers.

data

Optional layer data, an alternative to mutations.

annotation

Name of an attached SynProteinMutationAnnotation. Defaults to the first mutation annotation.

domain_annotation

Name of an attached SynProteinDomainAnnotation. Defaults to the first domain annotation, if available.

individual, species

Individual selector for SynSpecies; species is an alias consistent with other Syn-aware geoms.

genes, event_type, min_sample_count, strains, mutation

Mutation filters passed to query_protein_mutations(). Filters on counts or events do not truncate the selected protein's backbone or domains.

ids

Protein, transcript, or gene identifiers matching the mutation annotation's keytype. Use to distinguish isoforms of the same gene.

Value

A list of ggplot2 layers.

Details

Select one protein per individual using genes or ids. Domain records are matched through their annotation's keytype; when it differs from the mutation key, that identifier column must also be present in the mutation records. Use map_domain_ids() to reconcile identifiers when necessary.

For Syn input, the full length comes from protein_length, a stored protein_length column, or one matching sequence in protein_seq(). A terminal stop character is excluded from sequence length. A missing full length is an error rather than an inference from the last mutation.

Explicit mutation/domain tables remain supported, including their existing length inference. protein_lollipop_data() is available for inspecting layout tables but is not required before plotting a Syn object.
